question: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
evidence: single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) where bond_type = '-'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching molecule record.
gold: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id), 5) FROM bond AS T1 LEFT JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
gold0: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

b.request: Interpret as the percentage of single bonds (bond_type = '-') whose molecule is carcinogenic (label = '+'), computed as SUM(label = '+') * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) over a LEFT JOIN from bond to molecule, so single bonds with no matching molecule record are kept in the denominator and counted as non-carcinogenic, shown with five decimal places
b.sql: SELECT printf('%.5f', CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id)) AS percentage FROM bond b LEFT JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
